result.topic_en: Riemann argues that the continuity or discontinuity of the series for p x^{-mu} can only be decided by examining the equal integrals, which change continuously when the exponents mu-alpha-1 and alpha are positive; a footnote treats the integrals before the substitution of b/y for x.

Continuität oder Discontinuität der Reihen $p x^{-\mu}$ und
